entries.52bc53367dcfcea7: Its basic management policy consists of three points: expanding revenue and cutting expenses, managing corporate risk, and challenging new fields. Its medium- to long-term management strategy states that, for its core businesses of software development, operations management and support services, amid continued tightness in the supply and demand for IT personnel, it will work on improving engineers' technical skills, year-round mid-career hiring and proactive new-graduate hiring, and enhancing personnel and training systems aimed at improving employee satisfaction and retention. It also states that it will continue to build organizational structures and expand technical training opportunities to respond to related technologies such as the nearshore market, DX and generative AI, and will also continue to consider strategic M&A.
